title: 第二十一章 一次扣关第二十二章 红油鱼
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
“白猿靠山！”
夜色下，苏羽身形如弓，猛地弹射而出，肩膀狠狠撞击在坚硬的铁木桩上。
“嘭！”
一声沉闷的响声炸开，木桩竟剧烈颤抖。
“白猿抖甲”
他的体内气血开始高速颤动，发出崩崩崩的爆响，月光下，热气蒸腾，脊椎大龙起伏，活像一头披着人皮的凶暴白猿！
“砰！砰！砰！”
连续三拳，气血涌动，击打在木桩上，将木桩再次砸的阵阵作响。
这就是一次扣关的力量！
随意一拳，就超出了普通人的极限，放在前世，即使是重量级拳击手，也做不到！
如今，自己只是通过二个多月的修炼，突破一次扣关，就超过了前世的极限。
再来试试完整走桩！
苏羽一跃来到演武场中央，开始从白猿抱印开始，很快苏羽就察觉到了不同。
如今走桩起来，轻松写意，原本体会不到的发力诀窍，如今身体能够捕捉到了。
而且一套走桩下来，仅仅花了平时不到一半的时间。
【熟练度+2】
“好！竟然不靠汤药，直接加了两点熟练度！”苏羽停下走桩，拉伸着身体，“虽然熟练境界的突破熟练度涨到了1200点，但是自己走桩的效率大大提升了，再加上汤药，反而能比之前还快！”
“果然万事开头难，真的踏入武者之路，闯过第一次扣关的瓶颈，身体已经开始蜕变之路！未来只会越走越顺！”
顿时，苏羽对未来充满了更多期待。
翌日，苏羽久违的睡了个懒觉，或许是昨日练的太晚，亦或者心中轻松了不少，身心得到了充足的休息。

许多学徒们来到前院演武场，没有看到苏羽，反而觉得有些不习惯。
“苏羽这是怎么了，怎么没来？不是马上又要考核了吗，他怎么懈怠了。”
“肯定是突破无望，放弃了呗。他那根骨天赋，连马飞都赶不上，早晚被淘汰的。”
苏羽姗姗来到，听到不少流言蜚语，也不在意，自顾自的开始走桩起来。
一边走桩，一边思索，如今突破了一次扣关，但是身上银两又没了，还是要尽快去赚钱，否则汤药的供应就断了。
考核前先给徐师兄展示下突破的境界，然后告假，去黑水河捕鱼吧。
如今有了两次破限的撒网技艺，恐怕能捕到不少珍稀渔获，要是能弄到一条宝鱼，这修炼的资源短时间就不缺了。
“林师姐！”
“陈师兄！”
一阵骚动打断了他的思绪。
只见内院方向，走出一男一女。
男的是陈凡，身穿锦衣，意气风发。
content_en:
"White Ape's backer!"
Under the night, Su Yu's figure was like a bow, suddenly ejected, and his shoulder hit hard on the hard iron and wood pile.
"Bang!"
A dull sound exploded, and the wooden pile trembled violently.
"The White Ape Shakes Its Armor"
The energy and blood in his body began to tremble at a high speed, making loud banging sounds. Under the moonlight, the heat was steaming, and his spine was undulating like a ferocious white ape wearing human skin!
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Three punches in a row, energy and blood surged, hitting the wooden stake, causing the wooden stake to smash again.
This is the power of a slam dunk!
A casual punch is beyond the limits of ordinary people. In the previous life, even a heavyweight boxer couldn't do it!
Now, after more than two months of practice, I have broken through one hurdle, surpassing the limit of my previous life.
Let’s try the complete pile walk again!
Su Yu jumped to the center of the martial arts arena and started with the White Ape Holding Seal. Soon Su Yu noticed the difference.
Now that I'm walking, I feel relaxed and free-spirited, and my body can now capture the secret of exerting force that I couldn't understand before.
Moreover, it only took less than half the time to complete a set of walking piles.
[Proficiency +2]
"Good! I actually added two points of proficiency without relying on the decoction!" Su Yu stopped walking and stretched his body. "Although the proficiency level for breaking through the proficiency level has increased to 1200 points, the efficiency of walking has been greatly improved. With the addition of the decoction, it can be faster than before!"
"Sure enough, everything is difficult at the beginning. I have really stepped into the path of a warrior, passed the bottleneck of the first test, and my body has begun to transform! The future will only get smoother and smoother!"
Suddenly, Su Yu was full of expectations for the future.
The next day, Su Yu took a nap for the first time in a long time. Maybe it was because he practiced too late yesterday, or maybe he felt a lot more relaxed and had enough rest physically and mentally.
Many apprentices came to the martial arts field in the front yard. They didn't see Su Yu, but they felt a little uncomfortable.
"What's wrong with Su Yu? Why didn't he come? Isn't there another assessment soon? Why is he slacking off?"
"There must be no hope of breakthrough, so I gave up. His talent is not even comparable to Ma Fei's, and he will be eliminated sooner or later."
Su Yu arrived slowly and heard a lot of rumors, but he didn't care and started to mind his own business.
While walking the pile, I was thinking. Now I have broken through a buckle, but I have no money again. I still have to make money as soon as possible, otherwise the supply of soup and medicine will be cut off.
Before the assessment, show Brother Xu the realm of breakthrough, then take leave and go fishing in the Blackwater River.
Now that I have the skill of casting a net that has exceeded the limit twice, I am afraid that I can catch a lot of rare fish. If I can get a treasure fish, I will not be short of resources for this cultivation in a short time.
"Senior Sister Lin!"
"Senior Brother Chen!"
A commotion interrupted his thoughts.
I saw a man and a woman walking out from the direction of the inner courtyard.
The man is Chen Fan, wearing brocade clothes and looking high-spirited.
